name: v3_gentle_roll
comment: v3 stand (360 deg, no blockers), PSU only. COLL 500 hold was 'flat': a 3 deg target step got no roll response (moment <= 0.3 mNm, ~1% duty split), so check whether the rig turns at all. Gentle commanded roll: 10 deg step held 3 s, then a 10 deg 0.25 Hz sine. ATT_GAIN 0.85 (as flown) vs 2.0 (2.35x moment).
